༄༅/ /bkra shis kyi rnam bshad bzhugs/oṃ swā sti/bkra shis kun las rmad byung bkra shis pa/ /dge legs bla na med pa'i dge legs can/ /rin chen gas

tei:div.tei:p: oṃ swā sti/ bkra shis kun las rmad byung bkra shis pa/ /dge legs bla na med pa'i dge legs can/ /rin chen gsum gyi gzi 'od rin chen gyis/ /bde skyid don gnyer 'gro rnams bde skyid shog /'dir shis pa brjod par 'dod pas/ dkon mchog gsum gyi bkra shis brjod par bya'o/ /de la phun sum tshogs pa mnga' ba zhes bya ba ni/ chos kyi sku phun sum tshogs pa dang*/ gzugs kyi sku phun sum tshogs pa dang*/ 'phrin las phun sum tshogs pa ste/ ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba thun mong ma yin pa'i phun sum tshogs pa gang la mnga' ba ni sangs rgyas so/ /chos gang la'ang chags pa dang thogs pa med pa'i ye shes dang*/ sgrib pa ma lus pa rtsa ba dang bcas par spangs pa/ dmigs pa med pa'i thugs rje chen po ni chos kyi sku phun sum tshogs pa'o/ /mtshan dang dpe byad phun sum tshogs pa dang*/ stobs mtha' med pa dang*/ yan lag drug cu'i gsungs dbyangs dang ldan pa ni gzugs kyi sku phun sum tshogs pa'o/ /'gro ba mtha' dag gi sdug bsngal sel ba dang*/ khyad par can gyi phun sum tshogs pa la 'god pa ste/ rnam pa gnyis ni 'phrin las phun sum tshogs pa'o/ /gser gyi ri bo 'dra zhes pa ni/ sku kha dog bzang zhing gzi brjid dang ldan pas gser gyi ri bo dang 'dra ba'am/ ngo bo rab tu bzang zhing rkyen gang gis kyang mi g.yos pas gser gyi ri bo g.yo ba med pa dang 'dra ba'o/ /'dis ni sangs rgyas de nyid/ bzang ba'i phyir thugs rje chen po shes bya thams cad la 'jug pa'i ye shes rnam pa thams cad pa mthu thogs pa med pa dang*/ brtan pa'i phyir rtag cing ther zug la g.yung drung gi skur bstan pa yin no/ /gang phun sum tshogs pa mi 'jig pa de ni mchog tu phun sum tshogs pa ste/ de nyid kyi phyir gser gyi ri bo dang 'dra ba'o/ /'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po ni thams cad kyi skyabs dang skyob pa bla na med par gyur pa ste 'phrin las so/

/dri ma gsum ni 'dod chags dang zhe sdang dang gti mug ste/ de rnams bag chags dang bcas pa gtan nas spangs pa'o/ /padmo rgyas pa'i 'dab ma shin tu kha bye ba ltar shes bya thams cad la blo gros rab tu rgyas shing kha bye ba'i ye shes kyi spyan mnga' ba de ni sangs rgyas te/ dri ma gsum spangs pa ni sangs pa dang*/ spyan mnga' ba ni rgyas pa'i don no/ /de yang buddhaḥzhes bya ba la mo ha nī drā pra marda pra buddha pu ru ṣa ba ta/ zhes gti mug gi gnyid sangs pas na mi gnyid sangs pa bzhin zhes bya ste/ buddha sangs pa'i don dang*/ buddharbi kā sā nāta buddha bi buddha padma ba ta/ zhes pa blo gros kha bye zhing rgyas pas na/ padma kha bye ba dang 'dra/ zhes pa buddha rgyas pa'i don no/ /'di ni 'jig rten du dge ba'i bkra shis pa thams cad kyi dang por bgrang ba mchog yin te/ 'di bas mchog tu gyur pa gzhan med pa dang*/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i bde skyid thams cad sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi mthu las byung ba'i phyir ro/ /de yis nye bar bstan pa sogs ni ston pa des bstan pa'i chos te/ brda'i chos ni ston par byed pa'i tshig gsung dbyangs rnams yin la/ gang bstan par bya rgyu'i chos ni rnam grangs gsum ste/ blang dor dang 'brel ba bsgrub par bya ba'i chos lam dang*/ gang zhig thob par bya ba 'gog pa'i bden pa 'bras bu'i chos rnams dang*/ gang zhig rtogs par bya ba chos nyid yang dag pa'i mtha'o/ /mchog dang rab ni phyin ci ma log pa ma nor ba'i don dang*/ mi g.yo ba ni lung gi don la gzhan gyi skyon gdags pa'i sgo nas g.yo ba med pa dang*/ lam gyi chos la bor du rung bar btags pa'i sgo nas g.yo ba med pa dang*/ 'bras bu nyams pa mi srid pas g.yo ba med pa dang*/ de bzhin nyid ni gnas lugs su ma song ba'i sgo nas skyon gdags su med pas g.yo ba med pa'o/ /'jig rten gsum du grags pa ni/

sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa ma yin pa dag ni kha cig mi'i yul du grags che ba srid kyang*/ 'gro ba gzhan gyis gus par mi byed pa'am/ cung zad dga' bar byed kyang thams cad kyis ma yin no/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i bstan pa ni/ mtho ris dang sa steng dang sa 'og na gang blo gros dang ldan zhing bsod nams dang ldan pa/ ches che ba thams cad kyis bsngags te tshangs pa dang dbang phyug la sogs pa'i lha dang*/ kun 'gyed gzhon nu la sogs pa'i dge sbyong dang*/ drang srong rgyas pa la sogs pa'i bram ze dbang che ba che bar grags pa rnams kyang*/ rang gi blo gros la the tshom za zhing*/ de bzhin gshegs pas bstan pa la ni yid ches pas bstod par byed do/ /de'i phyir brgya byin la sogs pa'i lha dang 'khor los bsgyur ba la sogs pa'i mis mchod pa'o/ /chos kyi dam pa mchog sems can la bstan pa des ni skye dgu ste 'gro bar skyes tshad kyi sems can chos de la brten pa rnams kyi sdug bsngal rgyu dang bcas pa ma lus pa zhi bar byed pa ste/ de ltar dam pa'i chos 'di ni/ 'jig rten du dge legs thams cad rgyu gyur pa'i bkra shis su bgrang rgyu gnyis pa yin te/ sangs rgyas kyis bstan pa'i phyir na de'i rjes su ni brjod dgos la/ gzhan 'di las lhag pa med pa'i phyir gsum pa sogs phyis brjod par bya ba ma yin no/ /dge 'dun dam pa sogs kyis ni dkon mchog gsum pa 'chad de/ de lta bu'i chos mngon du byas pa ni 'phags pa yin la/ 'phags pa de nyid mang du tshogs pa ni 'dus pa'o/ /de la saṅgha zhes bya ba 'dus pa'i don dang*/ yang rnam pa gcig tu na/ saṃ ni dge ba'am bzang po'i don yin pa'i phyir/ skye bo bzang 'dun la tshogs pa ltar dge ba ste thar ba'i bzang 'dun byed pa yin pa'i phyir dge 'dun te/ dam pa ni 'phags pa'i skyes bu'o/ /chos lam gyi bden pa rgyud la ldan pa dang*/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i bstan pa thos pa mchog gi bkra shis kyis phyug po ste/

bkra shis ni dpal 'byor dang nor gyi don no/ /mis mtshon pa'i sa steng gi 'gro ba mi'am ci dang gnod sbyin dang grul bum dang srin po la sogs pa rnams so/ /lha ni 'dod pa'i khams kyi lha drug dang*/ gzugs dang gzugs med pa'i khams kyi lha dang*/ lhas mtshon pa'i dri za dang nam mkha' la spyod pa'i gnod sbyin lha ma srin rnams kyang ngo*/ /lha ma yin te thags bzang ris la sogs pa ste/ des mtshon pa'i yi dwags dang klu la sogs pa sa 'og na spyod pa thams cad do/ /de ltar na srid pa gsum gyis mchod pa'i gnas/ mchod par 'os pa ni 'phags pa'i tshogs rnams yin te/ nyon mongs pa spangs pa'i phyir yon cung zad phul yang 'bras bu mtha' med par 'gyur ba dang*/ rnam par grol pa'i lam ston pa'i phyir ro/ /mu stegs byed dang de'i ston pa rnams ni/ rnam par grol ba'i lam mi shes shing chags sogs dang bcas pa'i phyir mchod 'os khyad par can du mi 'gyur ro/ /srid pa 'di na tshogs pa ji tsam yod pa rnams kyi mchog dang rab dang phul dang gya nom pa ste/ bden pa mthong pas rang bzhin gyi ngo tsha shes shing*/ bdag nyid ngan 'gror 'gro ba ni srid la/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i bde ba gong nas gong du 'phel bar 'gro ba'i phyir/ rang nyid kyi dpal gyi gzhi dang*/ 'phags pa rnams gang du bzhugs pa'i gzi byin gyis bdud dang nyer 'tshe dag dengs shing*/ rtsod pa dang nad yams la sogs pa med par 'gyur la/ yon 'bul ba rnams kyi 'byor pa rgyas pa dang*/ mtho ris dang thar pa'i rgyu la skye bo rnams 'jug par 'gyur pa dang*/ rdzu 'phrul dang spyod lam dang chos bstan pas dad pa skyed pa la sogs pa mthong pa dang thos pa tshun chod kyang don mchog la sbyor ba'i phyir/ gzhan 'gro ba thams cad kyi yang dpal gyi gzhi'o/ /de ltar na 'phags pa nyan thos rgyun du zhugs pa dang 'bras gnas dang*/ phyir 'ong zhugs pa dang 'bras gnas dang*/

phyir mi 'ong zhugs pa dang 'bras gnas dang*/ dgra bcom zhugs pa dang 'bras gnas te/ gang zag brgyad po rnams dang*/ rang sangs rgyas rnams dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' 'phags pa phyir mi ldog pa rnams dang*/ rjes mthun pa mos pas spyod pa'i phyir mi ldog pa rnams kyang ste/ de dag ni 'phags pa'i dge 'dun zhes bya'o/ /don dam pa mthar thug pa'i dge 'dun ni de bzhin gshegs pa nyid yin cing*/ chos mthar thug kyang chos kyi sku'o/ /'on kyang re zhig 'dir dkon mchog rin po che gsum du bzhag ste/ theg pa gsum gyi 'phags pa'i dge 'dun 'di ni/ 'jig rten du dge legs thams cad 'byung ba'i bkra shis ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba bla na ma mchis pa grangs su bgrang rgyu gsum pa yin te/ chos ni bkra shis gnyis pa yin la/ 'di ni dam pa'i chos bsgoms pa las byung ba'i phyir ro/ /bde ba kun gyi gzhir gyur pa/ /bde mchog rin chen rnam gsum gyis/ /bde legs thams cad stsol zhig ces/ /bde dang phan pa'i sems kyis bkod/ /dpal bkra shis kyi rnam par bshad pa 'di yang tā ra nā tha'am ming gzhan kun dga' snying pos/ dpal bde 'byung gis bzung pa'i gnas gnyis par bkod pa'o// //zhus dag /bkra shis/ / mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/ bkra shis kyi rnam bshad bzhugs/ - PAGE 384 -- PAGE 387 -- PAGE 383 -
